reason: All the multi-sport logging and RPG stat titles I care about are already completely free, and I wouldn't pay for Pro when none of my friends might even be on the app yet.
objection: A social fitness feed is a ghost town if my friends aren't already on MOV, and paying for Pro before seeing if anyone actually joins makes zero sense.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing my regular padel and soccer crew actively using the app and sharing their workouts on the feed.
